world: Old rural Norway on the open coast, long ago. Lillekort and his twin are born in a wretched, crooked cottage with a sagging turf roof at the edge of a birch forest. Far away, the King's manor stands on a slope above a wide sandy shore by the open sea: dark log buildings with turf roofs around a long hall, all hung with black cloth while the princess is promised to three sea trolls, who come over the sea in black ships with black sails. Lillekort's sword has a golden hilt and a plain brown leather sheath. His magic ship is a wooden ship with two masts and white sails; when small, it fits in his pocket. The princess's three secret garments are of gold, silver and brass. The iron cable is a colossal chain. At the bottom of the sea stands a rock mountain with a door.
palette: Late autumn on the open coast: blustery days with yellow birch leaves and scarlet rowan berries, and a dark-green sea with white-capped waves. The three Thursday evenings lie under a huge, low orange moon, with silver sea mist drifting over the sand. At the wedding, candlelight makes gold, silver and brass glitter. Under the sea: cold green-blue gloom and the red glow of the troll's oven.

cast.look: A tiny, bold boy only days old but no bigger than a child of four, with the sturdy, natural proportions of a small child, a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls. An oversized knitted cap with blue-and-white stripes flops over one ear. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a far-too-big, much-patched grey-brown linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, baggy patched brown breeches tied with string and big, worn-out leather shoes.
cast.portrait: Background: the autumn forest of yellow birches and red rowans.

simplified.name: Lillekort
simplified.description: En svært liten, men smart og fryktløs gutt som drar ut i verden og vinner magiske gaver, beseirer troll og ordner opp med både kongerike og kjærlighet.

english.name: Littlecourt
english.description: A poor, bold, quick-witted boy who leaves home at birth, bargains for magical gifts, slays the three trolls, exposes Sir Red’s lie, and later rescues the elder princess from an undersea troll hall.

cast.look: The same tiny, bold boy, no bigger than a child of four, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls under his oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap. Now he wears a shining garment of pure gold that glows with its own light: a short, close-fitting gold tunic with a high collar and round gold buttons, gold hose and small gold shoes, with a golden-hilted sword in a plain brown sheath at his belt.

simplified.name: Lillekort i gulldrakten
simplified.description: Lillekort i drakten av gull som kongsdattera trakk på ham mens han sov. Han skjuler den under fillene helt til bryllupet, og da lyser det av ham.

english.name: Littlecourt in Gold
english.description: Littlecourt in the garment of gold the princess dressed him in while he slept. He hides it under his rags until the wedding, where light shines from him.

cast.look: A tiny, bold boy only days old but no bigger than a child of four, with exactly the same round face, rosy cheeks, small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and mop of golden curls as his twin brother, but with a cheeky, know-it-all grin. An oversized knitted cap with red-and-white stripes sits on his head. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a far-too-big, patched mustard-yellow wool jacket with the sleeves rolled up, baggy patched grey breeches tied with string and big wooden clogs.
cast.portrait: Background: a green meadow by a brook.

simplified.name: Kong Lavring
simplified.description: Lillekorts tvillingbror, like av utseende, som kommer når han blir ropt på og til slutt hjelper til med å løse floken mellom de to prinsessene.

english.name: King Lavring
english.description: Littlecourt’s twin brother, identical in appearance, summoned in need and ultimately used to ensure both princesses are fairly matched through a clever exchange.

cast.look: The tiny twin dressed in his brother's clothes, so that nobody can tell the two apart: a bold boy no bigger than a child of four, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls under an oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap, in a shining garment of pure gold: a short, close-fitting gold tunic with a high collar and round gold buttons, gold hose and small gold shoes.
cast.portrait: Background: a bright room of the royal manor with small-paned windows.

simplified.name: Kong Lavring i Lillekorts klær
simplified.description: Kong Lavring i klærne til tvillingbroren, så lik at kongsdøtrene tror det er Lillekort som kommer.

english.name: King Lavring in Littlecourt’s Clothes
english.description: King Lavring dressed in his twin brother’s clothes, so alike that the princesses think it is Littlecourt coming in.

cast.look: A slim, lively princess of about eighteen with a round face, a pointed little chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pale skin with pink cheeks and short, bouncy platinum-blonde curls. On her curls sits a small gold circlet shaped like a ring of oak leaves. She wears an emerald-green wool gown with long, narrow sleeves and a high round collar embroidered with tiny gold leaves, a thin gold belt and a string of small white pearls.
cast.portrait: Background: the Shore at dusk, with the flat grey stone by the water.

simplified.name: Kongsdattera (den yngste)
simplified.description: Prinsessen som skal hentes av tre troll, men som blir reddet av Lillekort og hjelper ham med en plan som avslører den falske ridderen.

english.name: The Younger Princess
english.description: The king’s daughter promised to three trolls, saved by Littlecourt, and the one he truly chooses; she helps orchestrate the wedding-day reveal.

cast.look: A tall, strong, broad-shouldered princess of about twenty-one, a head taller than her younger sister and quick on her feet, with a round face, a pointed chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pink cheeks and thick platinum-blonde curls tumbling to her shoulders, held back with a string of pearls. She wears a long coral-red wool gown embroidered with little white seashells along the hem, a belt of plaited silver cord and a silver thimble on one finger.
cast.portrait: Background: the Hall under the Sea, lit red by the oven.

simplified.name: Den eldste kongsdattera
simplified.description: Kongens andre datter, som trollet tok med seg til berget på havets bunn. Der sitter hun og syr til Lillekort kommer, og hun er både større og sterkere enn søstera.

english.name: The Elder Princess
english.description: The King’s other daughter, carried off by a troll to his mountain at the bottom of the sea, where she sits sewing until Littlecourt comes. She is bigger and stronger than her sister.

cast.look: A big, burly, barrel-chested knight of about forty, a head taller than most men, with a broad, puffy face that easily turns bright red, a big bulbous nose, small shifty pale-blue eyes under bushy brows, curly red hair and a huge, bushy fiery-red beard. He wears polished steel armour over a red tunic, a long bright-red cloak and heavy boots, and always has a big white handkerchief tucked into his belt.
cast.portrait: Background: the great old oak at the top of the Shore.

simplified.name: Ridder Rød
simplified.description: En feig og ærekjær ridder som gjemmer seg når trollene kommer, og prøver å stjele æren for redningen ved trusler og løgn.

english.name: Sir Red
english.description: A boastful court knight who hides in a tree during each troll’s arrival, threatens the princess into naming him as savior, and is finally exposed by proof and punished.

cast.look: A tiny, ancient hag, no taller than a small child and bent double so that her back curves like a hook, with a small, deeply wrinkled face like a walnut, a flat little nose, a wide toothless mouth and only one eye: a single round, shiny sky-blue eye in the middle of her forehead. Her thin white hair is in a tiny knot. She wears a long, faded lavender homespun dress and a big brown fringed shawl, and leans on a crooked stick.
cast.portrait: Background: a forest path among yellow birches.

simplified.name: Kjerringa med ett øye
simplified.description: Ei gammel, gammel, krokrygget kjerring med bare ett øye. Lillekort møter tre slike, og for å få øyet igjen gir de ham et sverd, et skip og kunsten å brygge.

english.name: The One-Eyed Hag
english.description: An old, old hag, bent double, with only one eye. Littlecourt meets three of them, and to get their eyes back they give him a sword, a ship and the knack of brewing.

cast.look: A jolly, stocky king of about sixty with a big round belly, a broad, ruddy face made for laughing, a bulbous nose, crinkly brown eyes, bushy chestnut-brown eyebrows, thick chestnut curls and a big, round, curly chestnut-brown beard clipped short like a bush. He wears a tall gold crown with seven points, each tipped with a round amber bead, a long rust-orange wool robe with a wide brown fur collar, a gold belt and soft brown boots.

simplified.name: Kongen
simplified.description: Kongen på kongsgården ved havet, som har lovet bort den ene dattera til tre troll og mistet den andre til et troll i havet.

english.name: The King
english.description: The King at the manor by the sea, who has promised one daughter to three sea trolls and lost the other to a troll under the sea.

cast.look: A sturdy, cheerful kitchen maid of about eighteen with a broad, rosy, round face, merry dark-brown eyes, a snub nose dusted with flour and thick black hair wound into a bun under a white linen kerchief. Her sleeves are rolled up over strong arms. She wears a long cornflower-blue homespun dress and a big white apron with soup stains, and keeps a large wooden ladle tucked into her apron strings.
cast.portrait: Background: the kitchen of the royal manor, with a big hearth and copper pots.

simplified.name: Kokkejenta
simplified.description: Kokkejenta på kongsgården, som Lillekort bærer ved og vann for, og som får fang på fang med bånd av gull og sølv.

english.name: The Kitchen Maid
english.description: The kitchen maid at the manor, for whom Littlecourt carries wood and water, and who gets armful after armful of gold and silver hoops.

cast.look: A huge, bloated sea troll about five times as tall as a man, with dusky purple-grey skin like an old mussel shell, crusted with barnacles and hung with strands of dark seaweed, a great sagging belly, long dangling arms and flat, webbed feet. It has exactly five heads on five thick, wrinkled necks, each with a long drooping nose, small round yellow eyes and a tuft of shaggy grey hair. It wears a kilt of old brown fishing net and carries a thick iron bar.
cast.portrait: Background: the moonlit sea and a black ship with black sails.

simplified.name: Trollet med fem hoder
simplified.description: Det første av de tre trollene som kongsdattera er lovet bort til. Det kommer farende over sjøen med fem hoder og ei tjukk jernstang.

english.name: The Five-Headed Troll
english.description: The first of the three sea trolls the princess was promised to. It comes storming in from the sea with five heads and a great thick iron bar.

cast.look: An enormous sea troll about ten times as tall as a man, with rough slate-blue skin, knobbly and shiny like wet rock, a broad, square body, short thick legs and huge webbed feet. It has exactly ten round heads in two rows of five, one row above the other, each with a flat nose, big goggling green eyes, a wide frog mouth and a scraggly grey beard. It wears a torn black sail wrapped around its middle and carries a huge iron bar.
cast.portrait: Background: the night sea in drifting silver mist.

simplified.name: Trollet med ti hoder
simplified.description: Det andre trollet som kommer for å hente kongsdattera, dobbelt så stort som det første og med ti hoder.

english.name: The Ten-Headed Troll
english.description: The second sea troll to come for the princess, twice as big as the first, with ten heads.

cast.look: The biggest sea troll of all, as tall as a hill, with dark peat-brown, lumpy skin like a bog, shaggy grey hair on its shoulders, a round belly and legs like old tree stumps. It has exactly fifteen heads stacked in a pyramid, five on its shoulders, then four, three, two and one on top, each with a round red nose, small blinking amber eyes and a shock of grey hair. It wears a huge patched sailcloth tunic tied with a ship's rope and carries a gigantic iron bar.
cast.portrait: Background: a huge orange moon behind dark clouds over the sea.

simplified.name: Trollet med femten hoder
simplified.description: Det tredje og største trollet, med femten hoder og ei jernstang som får jorda til å sprute femten meter til værs.

english.name: The Fifteen-Headed Troll
english.description: The third and biggest sea troll, with fifteen heads and an iron bar that sends the earth flying fifteen yards into the air.

cast.look: A fat, savage-tempered troll about three times as tall as a man, with smooth, shiny turquoise skin like a wet fish, a barrel belly, short bowed legs and big flat webbed feet. He has one huge head with a gigantic, wrinkly, trumpet-shaped nose that is always sniffing, bulging pale-orange eyes, bristly orange eyebrows and a long tangle of brown kelp for hair and beard. He wears baggy patched sailcloth breeches held up by a rope and a necklace of big shells.
cast.portrait: Background: the Hall under the Sea, lit red by the oven.

simplified.name: Trollet på havets bunn
simplified.description: Trollet som har tatt den eldste kongsdattera med seg til berget på havets bunn. Det er så brått og arrig at det river folk i filler, men det vil gjerne ha sterkt øl til gjestebudet.

english.name: The Troll under the Sea
english.description: The troll who carried the elder princess off to his mountain at the bottom of the sea. He is so savage-tempered he tears people to pieces, but he badly wants strong ale for his feast.

places.name: the Shore
places.look: A wide, pale sandy beach below the royal manor, curving along the open sea. Right at the water's edge lies one big, flat, grey boulder, and at the top of the beach stands a huge, gnarled old oak with wide, spreading branches and yellow-brown autumn leaves. Tufts of beach grass grow in the low dunes, and a grassy slope rises behind to the dark log buildings of the manor.

places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: A long, high hall of dark, honey-brown logs with carved pillars, painted rosemaling on the ceiling beams, small leaded windows along one side and a big stone fireplace at the far end. One very long plank table with benches runs down the middle, with a tall carved chair at its head. Iron candle-crowns hang from the beams, and a few black hangings are still left on the walls.

places.name: the Hall under the Sea
places.look: A vast, rough cave hall inside a rock mountain at the bottom of the sea, with dark blue-grey rock walls hung with seaweed and shells, and a smooth stone floor. A huge stone oven with a chimney glows red at one end, with two enormous wooden brewing vats and barrels beside it. A small closet with a plank door is set into one wall, and a heavy round door opens onto the green sea.

cover.prompt: The Shore at dusk under a huge, low orange moon. Tiny Lillekort stands on the sand at the water's edge with his feet apart, one hand on the golden hilt of his sword and his little ship peeking out of his pocket, gazing boldly out to sea, where a black ship with black sails comes looming through the silver mist. Behind him, the Younger Princess, wrapped in a black mourning cloak, sits on the flat grey stone clasping her hands, and high in the great oak Sir Red peers out between the leaves.

simplified.caption: Lillekort er bare noen dager gammel, men redd er han ikke.
simplified.alt: Lille Lillekort står i sanden i måneskinnet med hånda på sverdet og ser ut mot et svart skip i tåka. Bak ham sitter kongsdattera på en stein, og Ridder Rød gjemmer seg i et tre.

english.caption: Littlecourt isn’t even a day old, but he isn’t the least bit afraid.
english.alt: Tiny Littlecourt stands on the moonlit sand with his hand on his sword, looking out at a black ship in the mist. Behind him the princess sits on a stone, and Sir Red hides in a tree.

illustrations.prompt: Outside a wretched, crooked cottage with a sagging turf roof at the edge of a birch forest, Lillekort marches out of the door and down the path, chin up and cheerful, a small bundle of food tied to a stick over his shoulder. In the doorway behind him, his mother, a thin, worn-out woman in a grey dress and a brown headscarf, throws up her hands in dismay, and five small children peep around her skirts. Far down the road ahead, his twin brother Lavring is just disappearing round a bend.

simplified.anchor: Men det hjalp ikke.
simplified.caption: Så la han modig i vei etter broren.
simplified.alt: Lillekort marsjerer ut av ei skrøpelig hytte med et knyte over skulderen, mens mora slår hendene sammen i døra. Langt der framme på veien forsvinner tvillingbroren rundt en sving.

english.anchor: It did no good.
english.caption: Off he marched into the world to find his twin.
english.alt: Littlecourt marches out of a wretched hut with a bundle over his shoulder, while his mother throws up her hands in the doorway. Far down the road, his twin brother disappears round a bend.

illustrations.prompt: Beside a clear little brook running through a green meadow, Lillekort and Lavring stand on two flat stones facing each other and solemnly christen each other, each pouring a cupped handful of brook water over the other's golden curls, their striped caps held in their free hands. Both squeeze their eyes shut as the cold water trickles down. Their two little food bundles lie open on the grass with a few crusts left, and yellow birch leaves float past on the water.

simplified.anchor: Så døpte de hverandre med vann fra bekken og gikk videre.
simplified.caption: Så døpte de hverandre med vann fra bekken.
simplified.alt: Ved en bekk i ei grønn eng heller Lillekort og Kong Lavring bekkevann over hodet på hverandre. Ved siden av dem ligger nisteknytene.

english.anchor: So they christened each other with water from the brook and walked on.
english.caption: So they christened each other with water from the brook.
english.alt: By a brook in a green meadow, Littlecourt and King Lavring pour brook water over each other’s heads. Their food bundles lie open beside them.

illustrations.prompt: On a forest path among yellow birches and red rowans, the One-Eyed Hag, bent double over her stick with her single eyelid squeezed shut, holds out a short sword with a shining golden hilt in a plain brown leather sheath. Lillekort stands before her holding up her eye between his finger and thumb, a round, shiny sky-blue ball like a marble, with the shrewd, satisfied look of a trader who has struck a good bargain. Golden light falls between the trees.

simplified.anchor: Han fikk sverdet, og hun fikk øyet sitt tilbake.
simplified.caption: Han fikk sverdet, og hun fikk øyet sitt tilbake.
simplified.alt: På en skogssti rekker ei krokrygget kjerring Lillekort et sverd med gullhåndtak. Lillekort holder opp øyet hennes, blankt og blått som ei klinkekule.

english.anchor: The hag gave him the sword, and she got her eye back.
english.caption: The hag gave him the sword, and she got her eye back.
english.alt: On a forest path, a bent old hag holds out a sword with a golden hilt to Littlecourt. He holds up her eye, shiny and blue as a marble.

illustrations.prompt: Beside a babbling brook in a green meadow on a bright, blustery afternoon, Lillekort stands with one foot inside his little ship and the other foot lifted, arms out for balance, eyes wide with delight. Under him the ship is growing: already as long as a rowing boat and still swelling, its two masts shooting upwards and its white sails unfurling and flapping in the wind, while the grass bends away around its hull. The golden-hilted sword hangs at his belt.

simplified.anchor: Et lite stykke lenger fram klukket det en bekk gjennom ei grønn eng
simplified.caption: Han trådte oppi med den ene foten, og straks vokste skipet.
simplified.alt: Ved en bekk i enga står Lillekort med den ene foten i det lille skipet, og skipet vokser under ham. Mastene skyter i været, og seilene folder seg ut.

english.anchor: When Littlecourt had gone a little further, it struck him that it might be worth trying out the ship.
english.caption: He set one foot in it, and at once it grew a good deal bigger.
english.alt: By a brook in a meadow, Littlecourt stands with one foot in his little ship, and it grows beneath him. The masts shoot up and the sails unfurl.

illustrations.prompt: A wide view of the royal manor, a cluster of dark log buildings with turf roofs on a slope above the sea, every wall and roof hung with black cloth. High above it, a wooden ship with two masts and full white sails glides through the air like a bird, with Lillekort waving from the bow. At the windows people lean out, gaping and pointing: the King at the biggest window and six servants at the others, while four more run down the path towards the shore.

simplified.anchor: Folk på kongsgården hadde stått i vinduene og sett et skip komme seilende gjennom lufta
simplified.caption: Folk på kongsgården så et skip komme seilende gjennom lufta.
simplified.alt: Et seilskip flyr gjennom lufta over kongsgården, som er dekket av svart tøy. I vinduene står kongen og tjenerne og måper, og noen springer ned mot stranda.

english.anchor: People had been standing at the windows of the manor watching him come sailing
english.caption: People at the manor watched a ship come sailing through the air.
english.alt: A sailing ship flies through the air over the manor, which is hung with black cloth. The King and his servants gape from the windows, and some run down towards the shore.

illustrations.prompt: Evening on the Shore under a big, low orange moon, with sea mist drifting over the sand. The Younger Princess, wrapped in a long black mourning cloak, sits on the flat stone at the water's edge, weeping, and reaches a hand out behind her, begging him not to leave her. Behind her, Sir Red scrambles up into the great old oak as fast as his clanking armour allows, his red cloak snagged on a branch, calling down over his shoulder.

simplified.anchor: «Det er bedre at én mister livet enn to», sa Ridder Rød oppe i treet.
simplified.caption: «Det er bedre at én mister livet enn to», sa Ridder Rød oppe i treet.
simplified.alt: Kongsdattera sitter gråtende på en stein i vannkanten og strekker ut hånda. Bak henne klatrer Ridder Rød opp i et stort tre i full rustning.

english.anchor: “Better one life lost than two,” said Sir Red.
english.caption: “Better one life lost than two,” said Sir Red.
english.alt: The princess sits weeping on a stone at the water’s edge, reaching out her hand. Behind her, Sir Red scrambles up a big tree in full armour.

illustrations.prompt: Night on the Shore. Out of a black ship with black sails, the Five-Headed Troll comes storming ashore through the foaming surf, so huge and bloated that it blots out half the orange moon, all five heads glaring down, its thick iron bar in one fist. The Younger Princess stands weeping at the water's edge in her black cloak. Tiny Lillekort has just run onto the sand; he plants his feet and looks up with a bold grin. High in the oak, Sir Red hides among the leaves.

simplified.anchor: Idet han nådde stranda, kom trollet farende over sjøen, så det suste og bruste om det.
simplified.caption: Trollet kom farende over sjøen, og det hadde fem hoder.
simplified.alt: Et diger troll med fem hoder vasser i land fra et svart skip med ei jernstang i neven. Kongsdattera gråter i vannkanten, og lille Lillekort står modig i sanden.

english.anchor: Just as he reached the spot where the King’s daughter sat, the sea troll came storming ashore
english.caption: The sea troll came storming ashore, and he had five heads.
english.alt: A huge troll with five heads storms ashore from a black ship with an iron bar in its fist. The princess weeps at the water’s edge, and tiny Littlecourt stands boldly on the sand.

illustrations.prompt: Late at night on the Shore, in soft orange moonlight and silver mist, the Younger Princess sits on the flat grey stone with Lillekort fast asleep in her lap, his mouth open and his striped cap slipping over one eye. Smiling to herself, she carefully draws a shining little tunic of gold onto him, his rags folded on the stone beside her. The beach is empty except for the black troll ship rocking at the water's edge.

simplified.anchor: Det gjorde han gjerne.
simplified.caption: Mens han sov, trakk hun en drakt av gull på ham.
simplified.alt: Kongsdattera sitter på steinen i måneskinnet med Lillekort sovende i fanget og trekker en skinnende drakt av gull på ham. Ute i vannkanten ligger det svarte trollskipet.

english.anchor: “Now sleep a little while in my lap,” she said to Littlecourt
english.caption: While he lay there, she dressed him in a garment of gold.
english.alt: The princess sits on the stone in the moonlight with Littlecourt asleep in her lap, dressing him in a shining garment of gold. The black troll ship rocks at the water’s edge.

illustrations.prompt: In the warm kitchen of the royal manor, lit by a big hearth fire, Lillekort stands in the doorway in his rags with his arms piled high with shining gold and silver hoops, the kind that go round barrels and buckets, and looks up with a perfectly innocent face. The Kitchen Maid turns from her pot with her ladle raised and her eyes narrowed in suspicion. The wood basket by the hearth is empty.

simplified.anchor: «Å», sa Lillekort, «jeg var en tur hjemme, og der hadde disse båndene falt av noen bøtter.
simplified.caption: «Jeg var en tur hjemme, og der hadde disse båndene falt av noen bøtter.»
simplified.alt: Lillekort står i kjøkkendøra med armene fulle av bånd av gull og sølv og ser uskyldig opp. Kokkejenta snur seg fra gryta med sleiva i været og ser mistenksom ut.

english.anchor: “Oh,” said Littlecourt, “I went home for a bit, and these hoops had fallen off some buckets there
english.caption: “I went home for a bit, and these hoops had fallen off some buckets there.”
english.alt: Littlecourt stands in the kitchen doorway with his arms full of gold and silver hoops, looking innocent. The kitchen maid turns from her pot with her ladle raised, looking suspicious.

illustrations.prompt: Night on the Shore in drifting silver mist. The Ten-Headed Troll, twice as big as the first troll, looms over the beach with its huge iron bar driven halfway into the ground beside Lillekort, and sand and earth are still raining down from a fountain ten yards high. Lillekort stands unhurt and unimpressed with one hand on his hip, scoffing up at all ten heads, his other hand moving to the golden hilt of his sword. The Younger Princess, in her black cloak, huddles on the flat stone at the water's edge.

simplified.anchor: «Tvi!» sa Lillekort.
simplified.caption: «Tvi! Det var da noe til slag!»
simplified.alt: Et troll med ti hoder har slått jernstanga ned i sanden ved siden av Lillekort, så jorda spruter til værs. Lillekort står med hånda i siden og ler av det.

english.anchor: “Pah!” said Littlecourt.
english.caption: “Pah! Call that a blow?”
english.alt: A ten-headed troll has driven its iron bar into the sand beside Littlecourt, sending earth flying into the air. Littlecourt stands with a hand on his hip, scoffing.

illustrations.prompt: Misty moonlight on the Shore. Sir Red, just climbed down from the oak with bits of bark on his armour, looms over the Younger Princess and shakes a big finger in her face, his cheeks swelling red, making her promise to say that he was the one who saved her. She shrinks back against the flat stone in her black cloak and nods, frightened. Far behind them at the water's edge, Lillekort slips quietly aboard the empty black troll ship.

simplified.anchor: Da faren var over, krøp Ridder Rød ned av treet og truet kongsdattera til hun lovte det samme som sist.
simplified.caption: Ridder Rød truet kongsdattera til hun lovte det samme som sist.
simplified.alt: Ridder Rød står over kongsdattera og truer henne med fingeren. Hun krymper seg og nikker. Langt bak dem klatrer Lillekort om bord i det svarte trollskipet.

english.anchor: As soon as Sir Red could tell the danger was over, he climbed down from the tree
english.caption: Sir Red threatened the princess until she promised once again.
english.alt: Sir Red towers over the princess, wagging a threatening finger in her face. She shrinks back and nods. Far behind them, Littlecourt climbs aboard the black troll ship.

illustrations.prompt: A very wide view of the Shore at night. The Fifteen-Headed Troll comes wading out of the sea, much, much bigger than the others, so enormous that it blots out the sky and the orange moon, all fifteen heads in their pyramid glaring down, waves breaking around its stump-like legs. Tiny Lillekort stands alone on the sand far below with his feet apart. The Younger Princess clings to her flat stone, and in the bending oak Sir Red hugs a branch with his eyes squeezed shut.

simplified.anchor: Han var ikke før kommet ned til stranda, før trollet kom, så det suste og bruste om det.
simplified.caption: Det var mye, mye større enn de andre, og det hadde femten hoder.
simplified.alt: Et kjempestort troll med femten hoder vasser opp av havet og skygger for månen. Lille Lillekort står alene i sanden, kongsdattera holder seg fast i steinen, og Ridder Rød gjemmer seg i treet.

english.anchor: He had hardly reached the shore when the troll came, whistling and roaring.
english.caption: He was much, much bigger than either of the others, and he had fifteen heads.
english.alt: An enormous fifteen-headed troll wades out of the sea, blotting out the moon. Tiny Littlecourt stands alone on the sand, the princess clings to her stone and Sir Red hides in the tree.

illustrations.prompt: Aboard the black troll ship at night, lit by a lantern swinging from the mast, Lillekort in his rags kneels among open sea chests overflowing with treasure and fills his arms with gold and silver goblets, necklaces, jewels and shining hoops, grinning to himself. Black sails flap overhead and the orange moon hangs low over the sea. Nobody else is aboard.

simplified.anchor: Lillekort sprang hjem som før.
simplified.caption: Først var han ute på trollskipet og hentet en hel haug med gull og sølv.
simplified.alt: Om bord i det svarte trollskipet kneler Lillekort blant åpne kister og fyller armene med gull, sølv og edelsteiner.

english.anchor: Then Littlecourt ran back to the manor as he had the other times.
english.caption: First he went out to the troll’s ship and took gold and silver and precious things.
english.alt: Aboard the black troll ship, Littlecourt kneels among open chests, filling his arms with gold, silver and jewels.

illustrations.prompt: The wedding feast in the Great Hall, lit by many candles, with most of the black hangings taken down. At the head of the long table sits Sir Red beside the bride, red-faced and shiny in his best armour, a goblet in his hand, pointing in disgust at the door, where Lillekort comes in in his sooty rags, carrying a big pewter jug in both arms. The Younger Princess, the bride, in a tall silver bridal crown, calmly beckons him to her side. The King and eight guests look on.

simplified.anchor: «Hva vil du med den sotete fillegutten her inne?» sa Ridder Rød.
simplified.caption: «Hva vil du med den sotete fillegutten her inne?» sa Ridder Rød.
simplified.alt: I bryllupet peker Ridder Rød sint mot døra, der Lillekort kommer inn i fillene sine med ei stor kanne. Bruden vinker ham til seg, og kongen og gjestene ser på.

english.anchor: “What do you want with that sooty little ragamuffin in here?” said Sir Red.
english.caption: “What do you want with that sooty little ragamuffin in here?” said Sir Red.
english.alt: At the wedding, Sir Red points angrily at the door, where Littlecourt comes in wearing his rags and carrying a big jug. The bride beckons him over, while the King and the guests look on.

illustrations.prompt: In the candlelit Great Hall, Lillekort in Gold stands beside the bridal table shining so brightly that light spills across the whole hall, the pewter jug still in his hands. His sooty rags, a brass garment and a silver garment lie in a heap around his feet. Sir Red, beside the bride, has let his hand drop and gapes with his mouth hanging open. The Younger Princess rises from her seat in her silver bridal crown, beaming, and the King and eight guests stare in wonder.

simplified.anchor: Den tredje gangen slo Ridder Rød så hardt at sølvdrakten også falt på gulvet.
simplified.caption: Der sto Lillekort i gulldrakten, så blank og staselig at det lyste av ham.
simplified.alt: Lillekort står i en skinnende gulldrakt ved brudebordet, og fillene, messingdrakten og sølvdrakten ligger ved føttene hans. Ridder Rød måper, og bruden reiser seg og smiler.

english.anchor: But the princess said she wanted him to pour and no one else, and in the end she got her way.
english.caption: There he stood in the garment of gold, so bright and splendid that light shone from him.
english.alt: Littlecourt stands in a shining garment of gold by the bridal table, with his rags, the brass garment and the silver garment at his feet. Sir Red gapes, and the bride rises, smiling.

illustrations.prompt: At the long table in the Great Hall, the King leans forward and peers at the two proofs laid before him: on one side, a crumpled, tightly knotted white handkerchief that Sir Red holds out with sweat on his brow; on the other, a glittering heap of gold, silver and precious stones piled so high that the table sags. Lillekort in Gold stands beside the treasure with his hands on his hips. The eyes of the King are already on the gold.

simplified.anchor: «Den som har så kostbare ting av gull og sølv og edelsteiner», sa kongen
simplified.caption: «Den som har så kostbare ting av gull og sølv, han må ha drept trollene.»
simplified.alt: Kongen ser på lommetørkleet til Ridder Rød og på en stor haug med gull, sølv og edelsteiner. Ved siden av skatten står Lillekort i gulldrakten.

english.anchor: “Whoever owns such costly things of gold and silver and precious stones,” said the King
english.caption: “Whoever owns such costly things must have killed the trolls.”
english.alt: The King looks from Sir Red’s knotted handkerchief to a great heap of gold, silver and precious stones. Beside the treasure stands Littlecourt in his garment of gold.

illustrations.prompt: On the Shore on a bright, windy morning, a crowd of hundreds of men stands by stacks of barrels and sacks of food, staring. Lillekort in Gold drags one end of an enormous iron chain and lays its first heavy links into his tiny ship on the sand, and with every link the ship is growing: already bigger than a rowing boat, its two masts shooting up. The rest of the chain lies coiled in a mountain behind him. The King watches with both hands raised in astonishment.

simplified.anchor: Da alt lå klart på stranda, ville Lillekort ha trossen om bord først.
simplified.caption: Etter hvert som han hev trossen oppi, vokste skipet.
simplified.alt: På stranda legger Lillekort de første leddene av en diger jerntrosse i det lille skipet, og skipet vokser. Hundrevis av menn og kongen ser forbauset på.

english.anchor: So they brought it all, and Littlecourt told them to put the cable in the ship first.
english.caption: As he fed the cable in, the ship grew bigger and bigger.
english.alt: On the shore, Littlecourt lays the first links of a huge iron cable in his tiny ship, and the ship grows. Hundreds of men and the King watch in amazement.

illustrations.prompt: In the Hall under the Sea, in the red glow of the great stone oven, the Elder Princess has just dropped her sewing on the floor and claps her hands together in joy and astonishment. In the round doorway stands Lillekort in Gold, dripping wet, with a strand of seaweed on his cap and the end of the huge iron chain tied round his waist, trailing out behind him into the green water.

simplified.anchor: Der inne satt den andre kongsdattera og sydde.
simplified.caption: Der inne satt den andre kongsdattera og sydde.
simplified.alt: I trollhallen under havet slipper den eldste kongsdattera sytøyet og slår hendene sammen. I døråpningen står Lillekort, dryppende våt, med jerntrossen bundet rundt livet.

english.anchor: And with that he jumped overboard, so that the yellow spray flew up around him.
english.caption: She was sitting sewing, but when she saw Littlecourt, she clapped her hands together.
english.alt: In the troll’s hall under the sea, the elder princess drops her sewing and claps her hands. In the doorway stands Littlecourt, dripping wet, with the iron cable tied round his waist.

illustrations.prompt: In the red-lit Hall under the Sea, the Undersea Troll has just ducked in through the round door and stands with his head thrown back, his huge trumpet-shaped nose twitching as he sniffs the air, eyes narrowed with suspicion. The Elder Princess stands by the oven, pointing up at the chimney with an innocent face. Through a crack in the small closet door, Lillekort in Gold peeks out with one eye.

simplified.anchor: «Huff! Her lukter det kristenmanns blod!» sa trollet.
simplified.caption: «Huff! Her lukter det kristenmanns blod!» sa trollet.
simplified.alt: Trollet står midt i hallen og snuser mistenksomt med den store nesa. Kongsdattera peker uskyldig opp mot pipa, og gjennom en sprekk i kottdøra kikker Lillekort ut.

english.anchor: “Ugh!” said the troll.
english.caption: “Ugh!” said the troll. “I smell Christian blood in here!”
english.alt: The troll stands in the middle of the hall, sniffing suspiciously with his huge nose. The princess points innocently up at the chimney, and Littlecourt peeks out through a crack in the closet door.

illustrations.prompt: Beside the two gigantic wooden brewing vats in the Hall under the Sea, the Undersea Troll bends down low, glaring with his bulging eyes, and wags a huge finger right under the nose of Lillekort in Gold, who stands on an upturned bucket, cheerfully rolling up his golden sleeves and not the least bit afraid. The Elder Princess watches anxiously from the closet door, and firelight from the oven flickers on the wet rock walls.

simplified.anchor: «Det var godt jeg fikk tak i deg», sa trollet.
simplified.caption: «Sett i gang med én gang! Men Gud nåde deg om ølet ikke blir sterkt!»
simplified.alt: Trollet bøyer seg ned og truer Lillekort med en diger finger. Lillekort står på en bøtte ved de store bryggekarene og bretter opp ermene, og kongsdattera ser engstelig på.

english.anchor: “Lucky I got hold of you, then,” said the troll.
english.caption: “Get to work at once. And God help you if you don’t brew the ale strong!”
english.alt: The troll bends down and wags a huge finger at Littlecourt, who stands on a bucket by the great brewing vats, rolling up his sleeves, while the princess watches anxiously.

illustrations.prompt: The Hall under the Sea, full of steam and red firelight. Lillekort in Gold stands on a barrel by a huge steaming vat with a long ladle and hands a brimming tankard up to the Undersea Troll, who lifts it greedily to his mouth to be the first to taste. Behind him a dense crowd of trolls of every shape and size, big and small, fat and thin, jostle with their own tankards, waiting their turn. The Elder Princess watches from the closet door with her hands over her mouth.

simplified.anchor: Da vørteren sto ferdig og dampet i de store bryggekarene
simplified.caption: Nå skulle alle smake, trollet selv først og så de andre.
simplified.alt: I den dampende trollhallen rekker Lillekort trollet et fullt krus fra det store bryggekaret. Bak trollet står en flokk med troll og venter på tur, og kongsdattera ser på fra kottdøra.

english.anchor: When the brew was ready, they all had to taste it
english.caption: They all had to taste it, the troll himself first and then the others.
english.alt: In the steaming troll hall, Littlecourt hands the troll a brimming tankard from the great vat. Behind him a crowd of trolls wait their turn, while the princess watches from the closet door.

illustrations.prompt: A bright, blustery autumn day on the Shore, with no black cloth left anywhere on the manor above. The magic ship with two masts and white sails has come in to the beach, and down the slope streams a crowd of people led by two fiddlers. At the water's edge the King throws his arms around the Elder Princess, weeping with joy, while Lillekort in Gold steps ashore and the Younger Princess runs down the sand towards him with open arms.

simplified.anchor: Da de på kongsgården fikk se skipet, gikk de det i møte med sang og spill
simplified.caption: De gikk skipet i møte med sang og spill.
simplified.alt: Skipet har lagt til ved stranda, og folk kommer med sang og spill. Kongen omfavner den eldste dattera si, og den yngste springer mot Lillekort.

english.anchor: When the people at the manor saw the ship, they were quick to come down to meet it with singing and music
english.caption: They came down to meet the ship with singing and music.
english.alt: The ship has come in to the shore, and people arrive with singing and music. The King embraces his elder daughter, and the younger princess runs towards Littlecourt.

illustrations.prompt: On a wide green meadow outside the royal manor on a breezy afternoon, Lavring stands with his fists on his hips and a cross frown, having just given his brother a clout. Lillekort in Gold goes rolling head over heels across the grass like a shining golden ball, his striped cap flying off, while yellow leaves and grass whirl up around him.

simplified.anchor: Og dermed dasket han til Lillekort, så han trillet bortover enga.
simplified.caption: Og dermed dasket han til Lillekort, så han trillet bortover enga.
simplified.alt: Kong Lavring står med hendene i siden og ser sint ut, mens Lillekort i gulldrakten triller rundt og rundt bortover enga.

english.anchor: And he gave him such a clout that Littlecourt went rolling across the meadow.
english.caption: He gave him such a clout that Littlecourt went rolling across the meadow.
english.alt: King Lavring stands with his fists on his hips, looking cross, while Littlecourt in his garment of gold goes rolling head over heels across the meadow.

illustrations.prompt: In a bright room of the royal manor with small-paned windows, Lavring in Gold, dressed in his twin brother's clothes and looking exactly like him, has just walked in. The Elder Princess, bigger and stronger, has shoved her sister aside and throws her arms round his neck, kissing him soundly, his little feet dangling off the floor. The Younger Princess stumbles to one side with her arms flung out and her mouth open.

simplified.anchor: Kong Lavring tok på seg klærne til Lillekort og gikk opp på slottet.
simplified.caption: Men den eldste var størst og sterkest.
simplified.alt: Den eldste kongsdattera skyver søstera til side og kysser Kong Lavring, som har på seg klærne til Lillekort. Den yngste snubler til side med armene ut.

english.anchor: King Lavring was willing at once.
english.caption: But the elder, who was bigger and stronger, shoved her sister aside.
english.alt: The elder princess shoves her sister aside and kisses King Lavring, who is wearing Littlecourt’s clothes. The younger princess stumbles aside with her arms flung out.
